name: design-engineering
description: Interface craft and motion on the Svelte stack — building an animation from the decisions that determine whether it feels right, reviewing motion against a strict bar, auditing a codebase's motion into executable plans, finding the places that should animate and rejecting the ones that should not, naming an effect you can only describe, the component-craft philosophy underneath all of it, and Apple's fluid-interface principles for gestures, springs, materials, and type.
